payload.title: Company workspace and its /tenant landing have no gate: the workspace appears for anyone with an entry, the company dashboard admits every authenticated member, and module-less members land there, so a production manager cannot be denied Company
evidence: web/shell/src/console/nav/workspaces/org.ts:1-4 (no module gates the workspace; it appears for anyone with an entry)
web/shell/src/console/nav/pages/tenant.ts:15-22 (the company dashboard opens for every tenant user)
web/shell/src/console/nav/rootLanding.ts:28-35 (tenant admins and module-less members land on /tenant)
payload.rule_violated: D2: a production manager can be denied Company entirely.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-35, release R11.
